celebrates: Kansas City, Kansas celebrates Christmas across the Wyandotte County side of the metro. Bass Pro Shops runs Santa's Wonderland from November 14 through December 24, and Nebraska Furniture Mart holds SantaStravaganza weekends on December 12, 13, 19 and 20. Historic Memorial Hall hosts Donuts with Santa on December 12, Strawberry Hill Museum opens Olde World Christmas tours on six weekend dates from November 28, and the Kansas City, Kansas Public Library runs ornament workshops and paint parties. The Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting in Edwardsville is on December 1.
